register_coco_unlabel: register unlabeled COCO datasets by providing the root directory path containing images and annotations
register_coco_unlabel_instances: register a single unlabeled COCO-format dataset with name, metadata, json annotation file, and image root directory
load_coco_unlabel_json: load COCO-format JSON annotations and return a list of image records with file names, dimensions, and image IDs
build_coco_unlabel_dataset: build an unlabeled COCO dataset registration using detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog from a root path
test_coco_unlabel_loading: test loading unlabeled COCO images from JSON annotations and verify returned dataset record structure
